nights.title: Houndmouth
nights.name: Houndmouth
nights.extract: Houndmouth is an American alternative blues and rock band from New Albany, Indiana, formed in 2011, consisting of Matt Myers, Caleb Hickman, Zac Anderson, and Noah Denney (drums).
